if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
    project(tes3mp_standalone LANGUAGES CXX)
endif()

include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../cmake/TES3MPVerifyTargetBoundaries.cmake)
include(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../cmake/TES3MPRuntimeSafety.cmake)
include(FetchContent)

tes3mp_validate_runtime_safety()

option(TES3MP_ENABLE_GNS_TRANSPORT "Build the exact verified GameNetworkingSockets+c-ares adapter" OFF)
set(TES3MP_TRANSPORT_DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST "" CACHE FILEPATH
    "Manifest generated by the verified TES3MP transport provisioner")
if(TES3MP_ENABLE_GNS_TRANSPORT AND MSVC)
    set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY MultiThreaded CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
endif()

set(TES3MP_FLATBUFFERS_SOURCE_DIR "" CACHE PATH
    "Optional extracted FlatBuffers 25.12.19 source used instead of the pinned download")
if(TES3MP_FLATBUFFERS_SOURCE_DIR)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${TES3MP_FLATBUFFERS_SOURCE_DIR}/include/flatbuffers/flatbuffers.h")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "TES3MP_FLATBUFFERS_SOURCE_DIR does not contain include/flatbuffers/flatbuffers.h")
    endif()
    set(tes3mp_flatbuffers_SOURCE_DIR "${TES3MP_FLATBUFFERS_SOURCE_DIR}")
else()
    if(POLICY CMP0135)
        cmake_policy(SET CMP0135 NEW)
    endif()
    if(POLICY CMP0169)
        cmake_policy(SET CMP0169 OLD)
    endif()
    FetchContent_Declare(tes3mp_flatbuffers
        URL https://github.com/google/flatbuffers/archive/refs/tags/v25.12.19.tar.gz
        URL_HASH SHA256=f81c3162b1046fe8b84b9a0dbdd383e24fdbcf88583b9cb6028f90d04d90696a
        DOWNLOAD_NO_PROGRESS TRUE
    )
    FetchContent_GetProperties(tes3mp_flatbuffers)
    if(NOT tes3mp_flatbuffers_POPULATED)
        FetchContent_Populate(tes3mp_flatbuffers)
    endif()
endif()

set(TES3MP_ENGINE_INDEPENDENT_FORBIDDEN_INCLUDES
    "apps/openmw"
    "mwbase/"
    "mwworld/"
    "mwmechanics/"
    "mwrender/"
    "mwgui/"
    "SDL"
    "osg/"
    "osgViewer/"
    "GameNetworkingSockets"
    "steamnetworking"
)

function(tes3mp_add_engine_independent_library target source)
    add_library(${target} STATIC ${source})
    target_compile_features(${target} PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
    target_include_directories(${target}
        PUBLIC
            $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>
    )
    set_target_properties(${target} PROPERTIES FOLDER "TES3MP")
    tes3mp_enable_runtime_safety(${target})
endfunction()

tes3mp_add_engine_independent_library(tes3mp_protocol protocol/anchor.cpp)
add_library(TES3MP::Protocol ALIAS tes3mp_protocol)
target_sources(tes3mp_protocol PRIVATE
    include/tes3mp/admission_scope.hpp
    include/tes3mp/authentication.hpp
    include/tes3mp/command_primitives.hpp
    include/tes3mp/protocol_envelope.hpp
    include/tes3mp/protocol_exchange.hpp
    include/tes3mp/protocol_handshake.hpp
    include/tes3mp/protocol_frame.hpp
    include/tes3mp/session_types.hpp
    include/tes3mp/spatial_types.hpp
    include/tes3mp/strong_value.hpp
    include/tes3mp/value_types.hpp
    protocol/generated/authentication_accepted_generated.h
    protocol/generated/authentication_rejected_generated.h
    protocol/generated/authentication_request_generated.h
    protocol/generated/client_hello_generated.h
    protocol/generated/latest_wins_snapshot_generated.h
    protocol/generated/reliable_operation_generated.h
    protocol/generated/server_hello_generated.h
    protocol/generated/session_rejected_generated.h
    protocol/authentication.cpp
    protocol/protocol_exchange.cpp
    protocol/protocol_handshake.cpp
    protocol/protocol_frame.cpp
)
target_include_directories(tes3mp_protocol PRIVATE
    "${tes3mp_flatbuffers_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/protocol"
)

tes3mp_add_engine_independent_library(tes3mp_transport transport/anchor.cpp)
add_library(TES3MP::Transport ALIAS tes3mp_transport)
target_link_libraries(tes3mp_transport PUBLIC tes3mp_protocol)
target_sources(tes3mp_transport PRIVATE
    include/tes3mp/transport.hpp
    transport/transport.cpp
)

add_executable(tes3mp_transport_queue_tests tests/transport_queue_tests.cpp)
target_compile_features(tes3mp_transport_queue_tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(tes3mp_transport_queue_tests PRIVATE tes3mp_transport)
set_target_properties(tes3mp_transport_queue_tests PROPERTIES FOLDER "TES3MP/Tests")
tes3mp_enable_runtime_safety(tes3mp_transport_queue_tests)

if(TES3MP_ENABLE_GNS_TRANSPORT)
    if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_LESS 3.24)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "The verified transport adapter requires CMake 3.24 or newer")
    endif()
    if(NOT TES3MP_TRANSPORT_DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST
        OR NOT EXISTS "${TES3MP_TRANSPORT_DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST}")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "TES3MP_ENABLE_GNS_TRANSPORT requires the verified transport dependency manifest")
    endif()
    enable_language(C)
    file(READ "${TES3MP_TRANSPORT_DEPENDENCY_MANIFEST}" tes3mp_transport_manifest)
    string(JSON tes3mp_transport_schema GET "${tes3mp_transport_manifest}" schema_version)
    string(JSON tes3mp_transport_profile GET "${tes3mp_transport_manifest}" production_profile)
    if(NOT tes3mp_transport_schema EQUAL 1
        OR NOT tes3mp_transport_profile STREQUAL "tes3mp-phase6-slice6.1-static-caller-pumped")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Transport dependency manifest schema/profile is not approved")
    endif()

    set(tes3mp_expected_gns_lock
        "367fd5820e41b77c5857ccf1dff9b2d0698cebf8dba5385f81204f1dba64350c")
    set(tes3mp_expected_cares_lock
        "0ad50cda94dcca45fbfe3a7e166862ef3a572f9362ee3ada487872a6d018fec1")
    string(JSON tes3mp_manifest_gns_lock GET "${tes3mp_transport_manifest}" locks gamenetworkingsockets sha256)
    string(JSON tes3mp_manifest_cares_lock GET "${tes3mp_transport_manifest}" locks cares sha256)
    if(NOT tes3mp_manifest_gns_lock STREQUAL tes3mp_expected_gns_lock
        OR NOT tes3mp_manifest_cares_lock STREQUAL tes3mp_expected_cares_lock)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Transport dependency manifest does not match the repository exact locks")
    endif()

    foreach(name gamenetworkingsockets openssl protobuf abseil cares)
        string(JSON TES3MP_${name}_SOURCE_DIR GET "${tes3mp_transport_manifest}" sources ${name})
        if(NOT EXISTS "${TES3MP_${name}_SOURCE_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt"
            AND NOT name STREQUAL "openssl")
            message(FATAL_ERROR "Verified ${name} source is absent or invalid")
        endif()
    endforeach()
    string(JSON TES3MP_OPENSSL_ROOT GET "${tes3mp_transport_manifest}" installs openssl)
    string(JSON TES3MP_PROTOBUF_ROOT GET "${tes3mp_transport_manifest}" installs protobuf)
    if(NOT EXISTS "${TES3MP_OPENSSL_ROOT}/include/openssl/ssl.h"
        OR NOT EXISTS "${TES3MP_PROTOBUF_ROOT}/lib/cmake/protobuf/protobuf-config.cmake"
        OR NOT EXISTS "${TES3MP_PROTOBUF_ROOT}/lib/cmake/absl/abslConfig.cmake")
        message(FATAL_ERROR "Verified static OpenSSL/Protobuf/Abseil installation is absent")
    endif()

    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIB OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_STATIC_LIB ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(ENABLE_ICE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(USE_STEAMWEBRTC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(USE_CRYPTO OpenSSL CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
    set(Protobuf_USE_STATIC_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(Protobuf_DIR "${TES3MP_PROTOBUF_ROOT}/lib/cmake/protobuf" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
    set(absl_DIR "${TES3MP_PROTOBUF_ROOT}/lib/cmake/absl" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
    set(OPENSSL_USE_STATIC_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR "${TES3MP_OPENSSL_ROOT}" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
    find_package(OpenSSL 3.5.8 EXACT REQUIRED COMPONENTS Crypto)

    set(CARES_STATIC ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(CARES_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(CARES_INSTALL OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(CARES_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(CARES_BUILD_CONTAINER_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(CARES_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(CARES_COVERAGE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(CARES_WERROR OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    if(MSVC)
        set(CARES_MSVC_STATIC_RUNTIME ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    endif()

    if(DEFINED CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD)
        set(tes3mp_saved_cxx_standard "${CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD}")
        set(tes3mp_had_cxx_standard ON)
    else()
        set(tes3mp_had_cxx_standard OFF)
    endif()
    set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
    find_package(absl CONFIG REQUIRED)
    find_library(TES3MP_UTF8_RANGE_LIBRARY NAMES utf8_range libutf8_range
        PATHS "${TES3MP_PROTOBUF_ROOT}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
    find_library(TES3MP_UTF8_VALIDITY_LIBRARY NAMES utf8_validity libutf8_validity
        PATHS "${TES3MP_PROTOBUF_ROOT}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
    add_library(utf8_range::utf8_range STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(utf8_range::utf8_range PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${TES3MP_UTF8_RANGE_LIBRARY}"
        INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${TES3MP_protobuf_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/utf8_range")
    add_library(utf8_range::utf8_validity STATIC IMPORTED GLOBAL)
    set_target_properties(utf8_range::utf8_validity PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${TES3MP_UTF8_VALIDITY_LIBRARY}"
        INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${TES3MP_protobuf_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/utf8_range"
        INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES absl::strings)
    add_subdirectory("${TES3MP_cares_SOURCE_DIR}" tes3mp-cares EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    if(TES3MP_ENABLE_ASAN_UBSAN)
        set(SANITIZE_ADDRESS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
        set(SANITIZE_UNDEFINED ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    endif()
    add_subdirectory("${TES3MP_gamenetworkingsockets_SOURCE_DIR}" tes3mp-gns EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
    if(TES3MP_ENABLE_ASAN_UBSAN)
        target_compile_options(GameNetworkingSockets_s PRIVATE -fno-sanitize=function)
    endif()
    if(tes3mp_had_cxx_standard)
        set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD "${tes3mp_saved_cxx_standard}")
    else()
        unset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD)
    endif()

    add_library(tes3mp_transport_gns STATIC
        include/tes3mp/transport_gns.hpp
        transport/transport_gns_detail.hpp
        transport/transport_gns_detail.cpp
        transport/transport_gns.cpp
    )
    add_library(TES3MP::GameNetworkingSocketsTransport ALIAS tes3mp_transport_gns)
    target_compile_features(tes3mp_transport_gns PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
    target_compile_definitions(tes3mp_transport_gns PRIVATE STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_OPENSOURCE)
    target_include_directories(tes3mp_transport_gns
        PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include>)
    target_link_libraries(tes3mp_transport_gns
        PUBLIC tes3mp_transport
        PRIVATE GameNetworkingSockets::static c-ares::cares_static OpenSSL::Crypto)
    set_target_properties(tes3mp_transport_gns PROPERTIES FOLDER "TES3MP")
    tes3mp_enable_runtime_safety(tes3mp_transport_gns)

    add_executable(tes3mp_transport_gns_tests tests/transport_gns_tests.cpp)
    target_sources(tes3mp_transport_gns_tests PRIVATE
        test_support/fault_injecting_link.cpp
        test_support/in_memory_link.cpp
        test_support/manual_clock.cpp
    )
    target_compile_features(tes3mp_transport_gns_tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
    target_compile_definitions(tes3mp_transport_gns_tests PRIVATE STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_OPENSOURCE)
    target_link_libraries(tes3mp_transport_gns_tests
        PRIVATE tes3mp_transport_gns tes3mp_server_core GameNetworkingSockets::static)
    set_target_properties(tes3mp_transport_gns_tests PROPERTIES FOLDER "TES3MP/Tests")
    tes3mp_enable_runtime_safety(tes3mp_transport_gns_tests)

    add_executable(tes3mp_transport_gns_schedule_tests tests/transport_gns_schedule_tests.cpp)
    target_compile_features(tes3mp_transport_gns_schedule_tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
    target_include_directories(tes3mp_transport_gns_schedule_tests PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")
    target_link_libraries(tes3mp_transport_gns_schedule_tests PRIVATE tes3mp_transport_gns)
    set_target_properties(tes3mp_transport_gns_schedule_tests PROPERTIES FOLDER "TES3MP/Tests")
    tes3mp_enable_runtime_safety(tes3mp_transport_gns_schedule_tests)
endif()

add_executable(tes3mp_authenticated_join_tests tests/authenticated_join_tests.cpp)
target_compile_features(tes3mp_authenticated_join_tests PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(tes3mp_authenticated_join_tests PRIVATE tes3mp_server_core)
set_target_properties(tes3mp_authenticated_join_tests PROPERTIES FOLDER "TES3MP/Tests")
tes3mp_enable_runtime_safety(tes3mp_authenticated_join_tests)
tes3mp_verify_target_dependencies(tes3mp_authenticated_join_tests ALLOWED tes3mp_server_core tes3mp_protocol)
tes3mp_verify_target_includes(tes3mp_authenticated_join_tests
    FORBIDDEN ${TES3MP_ENGINE_INDEPENDENT_FORBIDDEN_INCLUDES})

add_custom_target(tes3mp_authenticated_join_tests_run
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_authenticated_join_tests>
    DEPENDS tes3mp_authenticated_join_tests
    COMMENT "Running TES3MP authenticated join contracts")

    target_link_libraries(tes3mp_server_core PRIVATE OpenSSL::Crypto)
endif()

tes3mp_verify_target_dependencies(tes3mp_protocol)
tes3mp_verify_target_dependencies(tes3mp_transport ALLOWED tes3mp_protocol)
set(tes3mp_server_core_dependencies tes3mp_protocol)
if(TES3MP_ENABLE_GNS_TRANSPORT)
    list(APPEND tes3mp_server_core_dependencies OpenSSL::Crypto)
endif()
tes3mp_verify_target_dependencies(tes3mp_server_core ALLOWED ${tes3mp_server_core_dependencies})
tes3mp_verify_target_dependencies(tes3mp_client_session
    ALLOWED tes3mp_protocol tes3mp_transport)
tes3mp_verify_target_dependencies(tes3mp_test_support
    ALLOWED
        tes3mp_protocol
        tes3mp_transport
        tes3mp_server_core
        tes3mp_client_session
)

foreach(target
    tes3mp_protocol
    tes3mp_transport
    tes3mp_server_core
    tes3mp_client_session
    tes3mp_test_support
)
    tes3mp_verify_target_includes(${target}
        FORBIDDEN ${TES3MP_ENGINE_INDEPENDENT_FORBIDDEN_INCLUDES})
endforeach()

foreach(target
    tes3mp_protocol
    tes3mp_transport
    tes3mp_server_core
    tes3mp_client_session
)
    tes3mp_verify_target_includes(${target} FORBIDDEN "tes3mp/test_support")
endforeach()

add_custom_target(tes3mp_protocol_tests_run
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_protocol_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_protocol_envelope_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_protocol_frame_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_protocol_frame_tests> --verify-corpus
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fuzz/corpus/protocol_frame
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_protocol_handshake_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_protocol_handshake_tests> --verify-corpus
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fuzz/corpus/protocol_handshake
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_protocol_authentication_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_protocol_authentication_tests> --verify-corpus
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fuzz/corpus/protocol_authentication
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_protocol_exchange_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_protocol_exchange_tests> --verify-corpus
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/fuzz/corpus/protocol_exchange
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_session_state_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_spatial_primitive_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_deterministic_facilities_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_deterministic_harness_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_fault_injection_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_observability_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_server_command_intake_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_canonical_state_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_server_command_reducer_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_server_core_safety_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_server_authentication_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_canonical_sink_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_server_core_property_tests>
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:tes3mp_transport_lifecycle_tests>
    DEPENDS
        tes3mp_protocol_tests
        tes3mp_protocol_envelope_tests
        tes3mp_protocol_frame_tests
        tes3mp_protocol_handshake_tests
        tes3mp_protocol_authentication_tests
        tes3mp_protocol_exchange_tests
        tes3mp_session_state_tests
        tes3mp_spatial_primitive_tests
        tes3mp_deterministic_facilities_tests
        tes3mp_deterministic_harness_tests
        tes3mp_fault_injection_tests
        tes3mp_observability_tests
        tes3mp_server_command_intake_tests
        tes3mp_canonical_state_tests
        tes3mp_server_command_reducer_tests
        tes3mp_server_core_safety_tests
        tes3mp_server_authentication_tests
        tes3mp_canonical_sink_tests
        tes3mp_server_core_property_tests
        tes3mp_transport_lifecycle_tests
    COMMENT "Running TES3MP protocol, deterministic facility, fault, and observability contracts"
)

if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../apps/tes3mp-server
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/tes3mp-server)
endif()
